description: This file contains functions related to handling player state changes, damage feedback, respawning, and event processing in the game 'Unvanquished'. It manages visual and audio feedback for damage, player respawn logic, event checking, and player state transitions.

methods.name: CG_DamageFeedback
methods.description: Handles visual feedback when the player takes damage, including view kicks and screen flashes.

methods.name: CG_Respawn
methods.description: Handles logic when a player respawns, resetting certain states and selecting weapons.

methods.name: CG_CheckPlayerstateEvents
methods.description: Checks and processes player state events, including external events and predictable events.

methods.name: CG_CheckChangedPredictableEvents
methods.description: Detects changes in predicted events and triggers corresponding entity events.

methods.name: CG_CheckLocalSounds
methods.description: Plays local sounds such as pain sounds based on health changes and game state.

methods.name: CG_TransitionPlayerState
methods.description: Handles transitions between player states, including respawn, damage, event processing, and view adjustments.
